terminology.autokognitive: The repository observes and reasons about its own execution, evidence, assumptions, failures, blockers, authority boundaries and repair effectiveness without treating self-description as independent proof.
terminology.autodidactic: The repository converts a reproduced failure and its causal repair into a generalized, regression-tested rule that constrains later executions and can itself be refined by new counterexamples.

purpose: Make causal debugging and learned prevention a permanent repository invariant for the Zero-Bug direction while preserving fail-closed evidence, authority and publication boundaries.

objectives: reduce recurrence of already diagnosed deterministic failure classes
reduce blind retry and false authority or credential escalation
reduce time from symptom observation to first causal blocker
increase regression coverage for previously observed counterexamples
forbidden_optimizations: weaken a gate merely to obtain green status
replace a failed privileged operation with identity substitution
blindly retry a deterministic failure without a changed causal premise

recursion.counterexample_policy: A new counterexample to an existing learned rule must reopen that rule as incomplete, preserve the earlier evidence as historical, add the new failure class or narrower scope, and rerun the same loop.
recursion.supersession_policy: A learned rule may be superseded only by an explicitly versioned successor that retains provenance and demonstrates the old counterexamples plus the new one.

initial_lessons.failure_signature: optional privileged credential shadows existing native read authority
initial_lessons.generalized_rule: Prove that a specific privileged mutation is necessary and that the native carrier is insufficient before escalating authority; optional privileged credentials must never become prerequisites for unrelated reads.
initial_lessons.scope_limit: Authority selection and credential routing; does not imply that every privileged mutation can be completed without additional authority.

done_semantics.local_zero_bug_claim: ZERO_KNOWN_DETERMINISTIC_BUGS under the exact declared and executed evidence boundary
